skills.description: Randomly seals 3 special tiles for 3 turns.
Every 2 moves, converts 1 to 3 tiles into blockers.
Generates corroded tiles and spreads/erodes in subsequent turns.
After being hit, reduces damage taken on the next turn by 50%.
Clears special tiles every 5 moves and triggers a shuffle.
Steals target resources based on configuration (settled asynchronously by presentation and logic layers).
Every 3 moves, dives onto a random normal tile, stays briefly, then converts it into a puddle blocker.
Every 2 moves, dives onto a random normal tile, stays briefly, then infests it with larvae.
Every 1 move, creates a 2x2 sticky patch around the gecko's current crawl position by adding sticky to normal tiles.
On each boss hit, ants plunder one random row from right to left, carrying away normal tiles and replacing them with configured blocker type (default paper ball).
On each boss hit, mutates random target tiles into configured special tiles based on skill parameters.
On each boss hit, poisons player special systems for a configured duration and applies toxic visual feedback.
